// Diagnostic codes discovered in the Java source.
// Add the matching entries to internal/diag/diag.go.
//
//   JSC_UNDEFINED_VARIABLE (error)
//   JSC_VIOLATED_CHUNK_DEPENDENCY (error)
//   JSC_MISSING_CHUNK_DEPENDENCY (warning)
//   JSC_STRICT_CHUNK_DEPENDENCY (disabled)
//   JSC_NAME_REFERENCE_IN_EXTERNS (warning)
//   JSC_UNDEFINED_EXTERN_VAR_ERROR (warning)
//   JSC_VAR_MULTIPLY_DECLARED_ERROR (error)
//   JSC_BLOCK_SCOPED_DECL_MULTIPLY_DECLARED_ERROR (error)
//   JSC_VAR_ARGUMENTS_SHADOWED_ERROR (error)

// Checks that all variables are declared, that file-private variables are accessed only in the file
// that declares them, and that any var references that cross chunk boundaries respect declared
// chunk dependencies.
type VarCheck struct {
	UndefinedNamesFromExterns map[string]struct{}
	Compiler *Compiler
	ValidityCheck bool
	StrictExternCheck bool
	// TODO: Java type RedeclarationCheckHandler not mapped
	DupHandler RedeclarationCheckHandler
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:77
func NewVarCheck(compiler *Compiler) *VarCheck {
	v
	return &VarCheck{}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:81
func NewVarCheck(compiler *Compiler, validityCheck bool) *VarCheck {
	v := &VarCheck{}
	v.compiler = compiler
	v.strictExternCheck = compiler.getErrorLevel(
        JSError.make("", 0, 0, UNDEFINED_EXTERN_VAR_ERROR)) == CheckLevel.ERROR
	v.validityCheck = validityCheck
	return v
}

// Creates the scope creator used by this pass. If not in validity check mode, use a {@link
// RedeclarationCheckHandler} to check var redeclarations.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:92
func (v *VarCheck) createScopeCreator() SyntacticScopeCreator {
	if validityCheck {
		return NewSyntacticScopeCreator(compiler)
	} else {
		dupHandler = NewRedeclarationCheckHandler()
		return NewSyntacticScopeCreator(compiler, dupHandler)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:102
func (c *VarCheck) Process(externs *rhino.Node, root *rhino.Node) {
	scopeCreator := CreateScopeCreator()
	if !validityCheck {
		NodeTraversal.Builder().SetCompiler(compiler).SetCallback(NewNameRefInExternsCheck()).SetScopeCreator(scopeCreator).Traverse(externs)
	}
	NodeTraversal.Builder().SetCompiler(compiler).SetCallback(c).SetScopeCreator(scopeCreator).TraverseRoots(externs, root)
	for _, varName := range undefinedNamesFromExterns {
		CreateSynthesizedExternVar(varName, /* isFromUndefinedCodeRef= */ false)
	}
	if dupHandler != nil {
		dupHandler.RemoveDuplicates()
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:132
func (c *VarCheck) ShouldTraverse(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) bool {
	return true
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:137
func (c *VarCheck) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsName() {
		CheckName(t, n, parent)
	}
}

// Validates that a NAME node does not refer to an undefined name.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:144
func (v *VarCheck) checkName(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	varName := n.GetString()
	if varName.IsEmpty() {
		CheckState(NodeUtil.IsFunctionExpression(parent) || NodeUtil.IsMethodDeclaration(parent))
		return
	}
	scope := t.GetScope()
	v := scope.GetVar(varName)
	if v == nil {
		if NodeUtil.IsFunctionExpression(parent) || NodeUtil.IsClassExpression(parent) && n.IsFirstChildOf(parent) {
			return
		}
		if NodeUtil.IsNonlocalModuleExportName(n) {
			return
		}
		v.HandleUndeclaredVariableRef(t, n)
		scope.GetGlobalScope().Declare(varName, n, compiler.GetSynthesizedExternsInput())
		return
	}
	if v.IsImplicitGoogNamespace() && v.GetImplicitGoogNamespaceStrength().Equals(SourceKind.WEAK) && StrengthOf(n).Equals(SourceKind.STRONG) {
		v.HandleUndeclaredVariableRef(t, n)
		return
	}
	currInput := t.GetInput()
	varInput := v.GetInput()
	if currInput == varInput || currInput == nil || varInput == nil {
		return
	}
	currChunk := currInput.GetChunk()
	varChunk := varInput.GetChunk()
	chunkGraph := compiler.GetChunkGraph()
	if !validityCheck && varChunk != currChunk && varChunk != nil && currChunk != nil {
		if varChunk.IsWeak() {
			v.HandleUndeclaredVariableRef(t, n)
		}
		if chunkGraph.DependsOn(currChunk, varChunk) {
		} else {
			if scope.IsGlobal() {
				if chunkGraph.DependsOn(varChunk, currChunk) {
					t.Report(n, VIOLATED_CHUNK_DEP_ERROR, currChunk.GetName(), varChunk.GetName(), varName)
				} else {
					t.Report(n, MISSING_CHUNK_DEP_ERROR, currChunk.GetName(), varChunk.GetName(), varName)
				}
			} else {
				t.Report(n, STRICT_CHUNK_DEP_ERROR, currChunk.GetName(), varChunk.GetName(), varName)
			}
		}
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:228
func strengthOf(n *rhino.Node) SourceKind {
	source := n.GetStaticSourceFile()
	if source == nil {
		return SourceKind.EXTERN
	}
	return source.GetKind()
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:237
func (v *VarCheck) handleUndeclaredVariableRef(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node) {
	CheckState(n.IsName())
	varName := n.GetString()
	if n.GetParent().IsTypeOf() {
	} else if varName.Equals(JSCOMP_CLOSURE_UNAWARE_CODE_SHADOW_HOST_NAME) {
	} else if strictExternCheck && t.GetInput().IsExtern() {
	} else {
		t.Report(n, UNDEFINED_VAR_ERROR, varName)
	}
	if validityCheck {
		panic(NewIllegalStateException("Unexpected variable " + varName))
	} else if !undefinedNamesFromExterns.Contains(varName) {
		CreateSynthesizedExternVar(varName, /* isFromUndefinedCodeRef= */ true)
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:267
func (c *VarCheck) EnterScope(t *NodeTraversal) {
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:270
func (c *VarCheck) ExitScope(t *NodeTraversal) {
	if !validityCheck && t.InGlobalScope() {
		scope := t.GetScope()
		for _, requiredSymbol := range REQUIRED_SYMBOLS {
			v := scope.GetVar(requiredSymbol)
			if v == nil {
				undefinedNamesFromExterns.Add(requiredSymbol)
			}
		}
	}
}

// Create a new variable in a synthetic script. This will prevent subsequent compiler passes from
// crashing.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:329
func (v *VarCheck) createSynthesizedExternVar(varName string, isFromUndefinedCodeRef bool) {
	nameNode := IR.Name(varName)
	if compiler.GetCodingConvention().IsConstant(varName) {
		nameNode.PutBooleanProp(Node.IS_CONSTANT_NAME, true)
	}
	syntheticExternVar := IR.Var(nameNode)
	syntheticExternVar.SetIsSynthesizedUnfulfilledNameDeclaration(isFromUndefinedCodeRef)
	GetSynthesizedExternsRoot(compiler).AddChildToBack(syntheticExternVar)
	compiler.ReportChangeToEnclosingScope(syntheticExternVar)
}

// Returns true if duplication warnings are suppressed on either n or origVar.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:436
func HasDuplicateDeclarationSuppression(compiler *Compiler, n *rhino.Node, origVar *rhino.Node) bool {
	if IsExternNamespace(n) {
		return true
	}
	return TypeValidator.HasDuplicateDeclarationSuppression(compiler, origVar)
}

// Returns true if n is the name of a variable that declares a namespace in an externs file.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:447
func IsExternNamespace(n *rhino.Node) bool {
	return n.GetParent().IsVar() && n.IsFromExterns() && NodeUtil.IsNamespaceDecl(n)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:526
func ReportVarMultiplyDeclared(compiler *Compiler, current *rhino.Node, name string, original *rhino.Node) {
	compiler.Report(JSError.Make(current, VAR_MULTIPLY_DECLARED_ERROR, name, LocationOf(original)))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:531
func (v *VarCheck) reportBlockScopedMultipleDeclaration(current *rhino.Node, name string, original *rhino.Node) {
	compiler.Report(JSError.Make(current, BLOCK_SCOPED_DECL_MULTIPLY_DECLARED_ERROR, name, LocationOf(original)))
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:538
func locationOf(n *rhino.Node) string {
	return func() any { if n == nil { return "<unknown>" }; return n.GetLocation() }()
}

// Lazily create a "new" externs root for undeclared variables.
// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:543
func getSynthesizedExternsRoot(compiler *Compiler) *rhino.Node {
	return compiler.GetSynthesizedExternsInput().GetAstRoot(compiler)
}

// A check for name references in the externs inputs. These used to prevent a variable from
// getting renamed, but no longer have any effect.
// Inner class VarCheck.NameRefInExternsCheck — ported as VarCheckNameRefInExternsCheck.
type VarCheckNameRefInExternsCheck struct {
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:4
func (c *VarCheckNameRefInExternsCheck) ShouldTraverse(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) bool {
	return !n.IsScript() || !NodeUtil.IsFromTypeSummary(n)
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:11
func (c *VarCheckNameRefInExternsCheck) Visit(t *NodeTraversal, n *rhino.Node, parent *rhino.Node) {
	if n.IsName() {
		switch parent.GetToken() {
		}
		t.Report(n, NAME_REFERENCE_IN_EXTERNS_ERROR, n.GetString())
		scope := t.GetScope()
		v := scope.GetVar(n.GetString())
		if v == nil {
			undefinedNamesFromExterns.Add(n.GetString())
		}
	}
}

// The handler for duplicate declarations.
// Inner class VarCheck.RedeclarationCheckHandler — ported as VarCheckRedeclarationCheckHandler.
type VarCheckRedeclarationCheckHandler struct {
	DupDeclNodes []*rhino.Node
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:5
func (c *VarCheckRedeclarationCheckHandler) OnRedeclaration(s *TypedScope, name string, n *rhino.Node, input CompilerInput) {
	parent := NodeUtil.GetDeclaringParent(n)
	origVar := s.GetVar(name)
	origNode := origVar.GetNode()
	origParent := func() any { if origNode == nil { return nil }; return NodeUtil.GetDeclaringParent(origNode) }()
	switch parent.GetToken() {
	}
	if origParent != nil {
		switch origParent.GetToken() {
		}
	}
	if s.IsGlobal() {
		if origParent.IsCatch() && parent.IsCatch() {
			return
		}
		allowDupe := HasDuplicateDeclarationSuppression(compiler, n, origVar.GetNameNode())
		if VarCheck.IsExternNamespace(n) {
			c.dupDeclNodes.Add(parent)
			return
		}
		if !allowDupe {
			ReportVarMultiplyDeclared(compiler, n, name, origNode)
		}
	} else if name.Equals(ARGUMENTS) && !NodeUtil.IsNameDeclaration(n.GetParent()) && n.IsName() {
		compiler.Report(JSError.Make(n, VAR_ARGUMENTS_SHADOWED_ERROR))
	}
}

// @ com/google/javascript/jscomp/VarCheck.java:62
func (c *VarCheckRedeclarationCheckHandler) RemoveDuplicates() {
	for _, n := range dupDeclNodes {
		parent := n.GetParent()
		if parent != nil {
			n.Detach()
			compiler.ReportChangeToEnclosingScope(parent)
		}
	}
}
